notes.title: Summer Waifu: Summer of Love and Puzzles!
notes.content: Get ready to meet [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3442380/Summer_Waifu/][b]Summer Waifu[/b][/url] – a unique puzzle game with anime heroines, which will be released soon! Subscribe and add to your wishlist so as not to miss the release, and become a part of this summer journey!
